name: Auto Insurance Live Transfers

hero.headline: Auto Insurance Live Transfers
hero.subheadline: Connect with high-intent consumers actively looking for auto insurance solutions.

overview: Auto Insurance Live Transfers are consumers qualified by our team and warm-transferred to your agents, generated by Altarious Global performance campaigns and delivered to your business in real time. Real-time auto insurance web leads delivered to your CRM the moment a driver requests a quote, with inbound call and live transfer options.

Live transfers extend the web-lead program with a fully qualified phone connection. Where a web lead is delivered for the agent to work, a live transfer is pre-screened by our team, which confirms the driver's state, vehicle, coverage status and interest before warm-transferring the call. Buyers often pair the two: web leads for volume and speed, live transfers for the highest-intent drivers who want to talk to an agent right away, giving captive and independent agencies a blended pipeline from a single source.

This product is suited to web leads businesses with a team ready to answer during defined hours, a clear view of the consumer they want, and the capacity to convert a live conversation. The acquisition objective is simple: put your team in front of auto insurance consumers at the moment they are deciding.
targetConsumer: Licensed drivers aged 18 to 70 who own or lease at least one vehicle and are currently uninsured, approaching renewal, or dissatisfied with their premium. The strongest segments are multi-vehicle households, recent movers, and drivers whose rates increased after a claim or ticket and who submit an online quote request to compare options.
consumerIntent: Typical intent signals include: submitted an online auto insurance quote request; comparing car insurance rates across providers; renewal notice received with a premium increase; recently purchased, financed or leased a vehicle.
howGenerated: Consumers are acquired through performance campaigns targeting searches such as "auto insurance quotes online" and "compare car insurance rates", plus social and comparison placements. Interested consumers speak with our qualification team before any transfer is attempted.
qualification: Qualification is configured to your appetite. Standard auto insurance criteria include: valid driver's license and vehicle to insure; located in a state the buyer is licensed to write; currently insured or uninsured status captured on the form; requesting a quote and open to contact; age 18 or older and the policy decision maker; provided tcpa consent for follow-up contact.
delivery: Once qualified, the consumer is bridged directly to your designated number or queue with a warm introduction. Delivery runs only during your operating hours with daily caps, and you can pause or adjust criteria at any time.

faq.q: How fast are auto web leads delivered?
faq.a: Leads are delivered in real time through direct CRM or API integration, so a driver's quote request reaches your system within seconds of submission while their intent is still fresh.

faq.q: Is consent captured on every web lead?
faq.a: Yes. Consent is captured at the point of submission and passed with each lead record, and delivery can be filtered to the states and ZIP codes your agency or carrier is licensed to write.

faq.q: Can I combine web leads with calls and transfers?
faq.a: Yes. Web leads are the core product, and inbound calls and live transfers can be added alongside them so you blend real-time leads with live phone connections in one program.
